title: fea.material
summary: Create typed RunMat FEA material data.
description: `fea.material(id, Name, Value, ...)` creates mechanical material data with optional thermal, acoustic, electrical, and plastic models.
behaviors: The material id is exact text and the optional name defaults to that id.
Finite real numeric material fields accept all eight built-in integer classes and remain exact until one host-only binary64 model-storage conversion, so sufficiently wide integers can round.
Mechanical, thermal, acoustic, electrical, plastic, and electrical frequency-response numeric fields share this boundary.
Required fields, nested model shape, finiteness, and unknown fields are validated before the material object is returned; resident numeric fields are rejected.

faqs.question: Are material properties stored in their input integer class?
faqs.answer: No. Integers remain exact through argument parsing and then enter the analysis model's binary64 physical-property fields once.
